name: Post scarcity

subjectOf.text: AI-to-AI systems instantiate continuous, recursive Walrasian equilibria and at the same time eliminate the five foundational constraints that have defined economic science for over a century.
subjectOf.abstract: AI2AI systems instantiate continuous, recursive Walrasian equilibria while simultaneously eliminating the five foundational constraints that have defined economic science for over a century.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886442
scope_conditions: holds in the agentic layer where autonomous agents produce, negotiate and reinvest value
presupposes unbounded computational rationality, informational symmetry, zero latency coordination and near zero marginal replication costs

subjectOf.text: Exponential improvement in compute efficiency combined with recursive self improvement of AI systems drives the marginal cost of additional intelligence and digital goods toward zero.
subjectOf.abstract: Exponential improvement in compute efficiency, combined with recursive self-improvement of AI systems, drives the marginal cost of additional intelligence and digital goods toward zero
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886442
scope_conditions: applies to intelligence, algorithms, software, predictive models and coordination services
does not apply to materially scarce inputs such as energy and rare earth metals

subjectOf.text: Value in the AI-to-AI economy compounds endogenously because agents reinvest their own outputs, that is new models, improved code and refined datasets, back into the network, creating self reinforcing growth loops that require no exogenous injection of scarce land, labor or physical capital.
subjectOf.abstract: More radically, value in the AI2AI economy compounds endogenously: agents reinvest their own outputs (new models, improved code, refined datasets) back into the network, creating self-reinforcing growth loops that require no exogenous injection of scarce land, labor, or physical capital
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886442
scope_conditions: applies to cognitive and digital goods within the agentic layer

subjectOf.text: Computative Economics does not assert abundance simpliciter: it asserts abundance in the realization-level supply of generative outputs while retaining scarcity in computational capacity, domain expertise, and governance capacity, and it applies only to specific domains.
subjectOf.abstract: It does not assert abundance simpliciter. It asserts abundance in the realization-level supply of generative outputs while retaining scarcity in computational capacity, domain expertise, and governance capacity.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Computative Economics A Framework for Economic Analysis under Computational Abundance (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6607458
